programme.title: Fantastiskās būtnes: Dumidora noslēpumi
programme.desc: Profesors Baltuss Dumidors zina, ka bīstamais tumšais burvis Gelerts Grindelvalds plāno pārņemt burvju pasauli. Nespējot viņu apturēt viens pats, viņš uztic magizoologam Tritonam Skamanderam vadīt bezbailīgu burvja, raganas un kāda drosmīga vientiešu maiznieka komandu bīstamā misijā. Viņi sastopas ar senām un jaunām būtnēm un iekļūst sadursmēs ar Grindelvalda pieaugušo sekotāju pulku. Cik ilgi Dumidors spēs turēties viņam pretī?

programme.title: Ātrs un bez žēlastības 3: Tokijas sacīkstes
programme.desc: Šons Bosvels ir pārgalvīgs sacīkšu braucējs, kam ir saspīlētas attiecības ar policiju. Lai izvairītos no cietumsoda, viņu nosūta uz dzīvi pie skarbā, atsvešinātā tēva, kurš savas militārās karjeras ietvaros atrodas Tokijā. Dzīvei rodas jauna garša, kad kāds cits amerikānis ar iesauku Tvinkijs viņu iepazīstina ar driftinga sacīkšu slepeno pasauli. Jau pirmajā braucienā Šons nezinādams izaicina D.K. jeb „Driftinga karali”, vietējo čempionu, kam ir sakari ar japāņu mafiju Jakudzu. Kad Šons iemīlas D.K. draudzenē, stāvoklis kļūst vēl jo bīstamāks...

programme.title: Zaļknābis pie stūres
programme.desc: Viņš ir ļoti jauns un prot ļoti ātri un labi braukt, kad ātri jātiek prom no nozieguma vietas. Tas ir neviens cits kā labākais auto vadītājs, saukts par Mazo. Kad Mazais satiek savu sapņu meiteni, viņš vēlas pamest noziedzīgo pasauli. Taču tas nav tik vienkārši kā šķiet, kad Mazais tiek iesaistīts vēl vienā noziegumā, kas apdraud viņa dzīvi, mīlestību un brīvību.

programme.title: Doktors Hauss 8
programme.desc: Seriāla pēdējā sezona ir klāt! Medicīnas spožākais prāts atgriežas, turpinot atklāt nopietnu slimību cēloņus un darot visu, arī pārkāpjot robežas, lai glābtu pacientu dzīvības. Ir pagājis gads, kopš Hauss ietriecās Kadijas mājā. Tagad viņš atrodas aiz restēm, bet jau pavisam drīz pārlieku tiešais un atklātais ārsts būs uz brīvām kājām. Atgriežoties ierastajā ārsta ikdienā, viņš atklās, ka daudz kas pa šo laiku tomēr ir mainījies. Tomēr pats Hauss nav kļuvis citāds - viņš turpina iet savu skarbā vīra ceļu un vājš kļūst tikai dažu sieviešu priekšā... Kad Hausa iemīļotā ielasmeita Emīlija nolemj precēties, viņš ir apņēmības pilns izjaukt sievietes vēl plaukumā esošās attiecības.

programme.title: Dzīve Tarongas zoodārzā
programme.desc: Raidījuma 7. sezona aicina skatītājus aizkulisēs, kur Sidnejas ikoniskajā zooloģiskajā dārzā ik dienu risinās neparasti dzīvnieku glābšanas un aprūpes stāsti. No paaugstināta riska dzīvnieku transportēšanas un uzvedības aktivizēšanas līdz aizkustinošai izglābto iemītnieku laišanai brīvībā – šis ir iedvesmojošs stāsts par Tarongas darbinieku pašaizliedzību un cīņu par sugu saglabāšanu.

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna – amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: Dr. Sirmais S03
programme.desc: Dr. Sirmais savā virtuvē uzņems visnotaļ harizmātisku viesi – dāmu mīluli, dziedātāju Ainaru Bumbieri. Šī tikšanās solās būt ne tikai izklaidējoša, bet arī izzinoša, turklāt skatītājiem būs iespēja iepazīties ar neierastām ēdienu kombinācijām. Dziedātājs būs gatavs pat neparastākajiem eksperimentiem, tostarp nobaudīt rapšu eļļu tieši no tasītes, lai pārbaudītu tās vērtīgās īpašības. Raidījuma laikā abi kungi pievērsīsies kulinārijas klasikai, sagatavojot iespaidīgu maltīšu klāstu – no sulīgas vistas un maiga laša līdz sātīgiem makaroniem un perfekti ceptam steikam. Īpaša uzmanība tiks veltīta detaļām, pagatavojot trīs dažādas salātu mērces, kas spēj pilnībā mainīt maltītes garšas nianses. Atliek vien noskaidrot, vai šarmantajam dziedātājam daktera stingrie, bet vērtīgie ieteikumi liksies noderīgi un vai viņš būs gatavs tos ieviest arī savā ikdienā?

programme.title: Caur ērkšķiem uz... 8.sezona
programme.desc: Attiecību eksperta Kristapa Ozoliņa lekcija par seksu, intimitāti un personiskajām robežām “Caur ērkšķiem uz…” dalībniecēm liek sastapties ar jautājumiem, uz kuriem ne visas gatavas atbildēt - Ineta pat lūdz iespēju nepiedalīties. Tantras nodarbībā uzticēšanās citai citai kļūst par īstu pārbaudījumu, bet iepazīšanās ar intīmprecēm kautrību mij ar drosmīgiem jokiem. Vakaru noslēdz enerģētisks biodejas rituāls, bet nākamajā dienā pārrunātās robežas nākas pārbaudīt sadzīviski: Martas ieilgusī tetovēšana kemperī un Skaidrītes palikšana aiz durvīm aizsāk skaļu konfliktu. Ginta un Līga iesaistās viņas aizstāvībā, un līdzšinējās draudzības sāk šķobīties. Spriedze nepazūd arī nākamajā dienā - pat kemperu mazgāšanas laikā uzvirmo pārmetumi, bet sarunas arvien biežāk aizved pie vietām finālā. Vai iespējams, ka balsojumā vakardienas sabiedrotās jau kļūs par tām, pret kurām tiek vērstas dalībnieču balsis?

programme.title: Amerikas smieklīgākie video: Dzīvnieki 2
programme.desc: Pasaulē ik dienu notiek komiski, jocīgi, neizprotami un smieklīgi atgadījumi, tomēr tikai retajiem paveicas šos kadrus notvert videoformātā. Laiks pasmieties par neveiklībām, jokiem, izjokošanām, kļūmīgām situācijām, kuras iesūtījuši Amerikas iedzīvotāji, un šoreiz joku epicentrā ir neviens cits kā dzīvnieki. Katrā raidījumā tiek atlasīti trīs labākie video, un uzvarētājs, kuru nosaka skatītāji, iegūst vērtīgu naudas balvu.

programme.title: Džeimss Bonds. Ar pasauli nepietiek
programme.desc: Pēc britu naftas magnāta slepkavības Džeimsam Bondam uzticēts sargāt viņa meitu Elektru Kingu. Pastāv pamatotas aizdomas, ka sievietes dzīvību apdraud vīrietis, kurš nespēj izjust fiziskas sāpes, jo viņa galvā iešauta lode. Bonda un zinātnieces savienība pavisam drīz nāk uz pēdām tam, ka spēles likmes ir daudz augstākas, nekā vienas naftas kompānijas nākotne. Lomās: Pīrs Borsnans, Sofija Marso, Roberts Kārlails, Denīza Ričardsa, Robijs Koltreins, Džūdija Denča, Džons Klīzs u.c.

programme.title: Komisārs Reksis Vīnē
programme.desc: Pasaulē slavenākais četrkājainais detektīvs Reksis atgriežas pie savām saknēm – skaistajā Vīnē, kur kopā ar partneri, detektīvu Maksu Šteineru, risinās pat vissarežģītākās krimināllietas. Ar savu aso ožu, izcilo intuīciju un apbrīnojamo atjautību Reksis spēj uziet pēdas noziedzniekiem, pirms citiem izdodas atrast kaut mazāko pavedienu. Bet brīžos, kad situācija kļūst bīstama, viņš vienmēr ir gatavs steigties palīgā savam partnerim. “Komisārs Reksis” ir viens no starptautiski veiksmīgākajiem televīzijas seriāliem, kas ir iekarojis skatītāju sirdis visā pasaulē. Tagad leģendārais detektīvs atgriežas Vīnē, lai jaunā versijā turpinātu aizraujošos piedzīvojumus un pierādītu, ka noziedzības apkarošanā uzticams četrkājainais partneris ir neaizstājams.

programme.title: TIEŠRAIDE! Līmenis. Izbalsošana
programme.desc: Tiešraide! Sociālās realitātes spēles Līmenis iknedēļas izbalsošana.

programme.title: Izklausies redzēts
programme.desc: No roka dumpinieciskuma līdz latviešu mūzikas zelta fondam – šajā vakarā netrūks ne spilgtu emociju, ne pārsteigumu! Ralfs Eilands iejutīsies grupas „Guns N’ Roses” solista Aksla Rouza tēlā, bet Maksims Busels pārtaps rokmūzikas leģendā Ozijā Osbornā. Ieva Sutugova uzburs Brodvejas mūzikla „Kabarē” atmosfēru, iemiesojoties leģendārajā Laizā Minelli, savukārt Lelde Dreimane pārtaps grupas „Čikāgas piecīši” dalībniekā Armandā Birkenā. Andri Ērgli gaida īpaši emocionāls izaicinājums – pārvērsties dziedātājā Ievā Akuraterē, bet Elīna Fūrmane iejutīsies enerģiskās Olgas Rajeckas tēlā. Savukārt Krisy pārstāvēs mūsdienu Latvijas alternatīvo popmūziku, pārtopot grupas „Kautkaili” solistē Kristīnē Pāžē. Visu šo krāsaino un talantīgo „kokteili“ kopā ar Jāni Šipkevicu un Mārtiņu Eglienu vērtēs grupas „Prāta vētra“ dalībnieks Jānis Jubalts.

programme.title: Cilvēks vilcienā
programme.desc: Sazvērestību trilleris ar Laiemu Nīsonu. Apdrošināšanas aģents Maikls jau desmit gadus diendienā pēc darba dodas mājup ar vilcienu. Vienu vakaru viņam līdzās apsēžas noslēpumaina svešiniece, un viņu saruna aizsāk dramatisku un neparedzamu notikumu virkni. Maikla uzdevums ir daudzo pasažieru vidū atrast kādu neiederīgu personu, pirms vilciens sasniedzis gala staciju. Laiks iet, un, šķetinot šo mīklu, Maikls apjauš, ka ir ierauts noziedzīgā sazvērestībā. Uz spēles ir likta ne tikai viņa, bet arī visu pasažieru dzīvība.

programme.title: Daniels Vebsters un velns
programme.desc: Spriedzes filma ar Entoniju Hopkinsu, Aleku Boldvinu, Kimu Ketrelu un Dženiferu Lovu Hjūitu. Jauns Ņujorkas rakstnieks noslēdz līgumu ar Sātanu – panākumus literatūrā un iespēju kļūt par bestselleru autoru viņš gatavs mainīt pret savu dvēseli, kas tiks paņemta pēc desmit gadiem. Gadi paskrien vēja ātrumā, un drīz vien panākumiem bagātais rakstnieks ir spiests lūgt palīdzību prasmīgam advokātam un ievērojamākās Ņujorkas izdevniecības vadītājam Danielam Vebsteram, lai tiktu vaļā no noslēgtā līguma. Rezultātā tiesas process izvēršas par aizraujošu debašu un spēcīgu prātu cīņu, kurā galvenās lomas spēlē Sātans un Daniels Vebsters, bet uz kārts likta rakstnieka dvēsele.

programme.title: Detektīvs Kolumbo 6
programme.desc: Losandželosas slepkavību izmeklētājs leitnants Kolumbo varbūt ir necils pēc izskata un uzvedības – vienkārši ģērbies, kluss un pieklājīgs, skumji smēķē savu cigāru. Tomēr šī neievērojamā āriene slēpj, iespējams, neatlaidīgāko un drosmīgāko izmeklētāju pilsētā. Tieši Kolumbo tiek iedalītas skaļākās un sarežģītākās lietas, kurās iesaistīts Losandželosas pilsētas zieds – slavenie, bagātie un ietekmīgie. Ieraugot Kolumbo, vainīgie bieži jūtas uzjautrināti un drošībā – šis vīrs nebūs spējīgs viņus izskaitļot. Kolumbo pierādīs pretējo! Galvenajās lomās: Pīters Folks, Maiks Lalijs, Freds Dreipers

programme.title: Vilcienā cauri pasaulei 3
programme.desc: Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens — tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram – tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

programme.title: 15 jautājumi 2
programme.desc: Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši – katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni – vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais – pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.

programme.desc: Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē “Viens pret visiem” spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi – slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam – būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna – amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: SOKO Leipciga 21
programme.desc: Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO – labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus – gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus. Galvenajās lomās: Melānija Marške, Marko Girnts, Štefans Šrūders, Nilama Faruka

programme.title: NCIS: Losandželosa 5
programme.desc: Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi – viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus. Galvenajās lomās: Kriss O’Donels, LL Cool J, Linda Hanta

programme.title: CSI Maiami 1
programme.desc: Kolēģu iecerētais kaisles brīdis beidzas vēl nesācies – noīrētajā bungalo pārītis atrod mirušu sievieti, kura izrādās ir prostitūta. Notikušais CSI izmeklētājus aizved pie kāda vīrieša, kura pagātne slēpj tumšus noslēpumus. Tikmēr Ēriks un Kalija izmeklē aplaupīšanas gadījumu, kad bojā gājis vācu tūrists. Visi pierādījumi gan liecina par to, ka te ož pēc slepkavības.

programme.title: Līmenis
programme.desc: Latvijā vēl nebijuša mēroga sociālās realitātes spēle, kas 35 dienas 24 stundas diennaktī ļaus skatītājiem reāllaikā sekot līdzi tam, kādi brīnumi notiek, kad tā dalībniekus, tādus pašus cilvēkus kā ikviens no mums, sadala divās krasi atšķirīgās pasaulēs. Vieni baudīs komfortu un privilēģijas, kamēr otri dzīvos daudz skarbākos apstākļos, strādās, pelnīs un cīnīsies par iespēju uzlabot dzīves apstākļus. Abas pasaules būs cieši saistītas, bet spēles gaitu nemitīgi mainīs skatītāju balsojumi, izbalsošanas, dalībnieku rotācija un iespēja pāriet no viena līmeņa uz otru. Līmenis - tā ir sociālā piramīda realitātes šova formātā, kurā tiek pārbaudītas ne tikai dalībnieku izdzīvošanas spējas, bet arī viņu attiecības, vērtības un priekšstati par taisnīgumu. Līmenis 24/7 skatāms tiešraidē Tet+, bet televīzijas skatītāji var sekot līdzi ikdienas 30 minūšu epizodēm un iknedēļas izbalsošanas tiešraidēm.

The evening is further ruined by a self-obsessed movie star at the next table. After a swim in the lobster tank, Mr. Bean unwittingly cooks up sweet revenge in the kitchen.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: With Baby Owl bored to tears, the Baby Lemmings have invented a new game: figurines made from acorns. With them, they create a kind of small village in their own playmobile style. Baby Owl would like to play with them, but clumsily destroys the whole village. Thinking she's done it on purpose, the Baby Lemmings run away from her in the hope of being able to play in peace.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: After a run-in with Bugs Yosemite Sam's cell phone gets scratched. He decides it's time to upgrade but little does he know that Bugs is there to help.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Rock Hardcase a fitness guru shows up to pull a fast one on the unsuspecting animals of the forest. Bugs proves to be an extremely difficult customer.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1

programme.desc: When Redbird tries his hand at espionage as “V-8, the Super-Spy”, he quickly realizes he's gotten in over his head, so Redbird teams up with Bibi to save the Amusement Mile from Dr. Spy!

programme.desc: Bibi has a terrible no-good day after she keeps messing up and lets Joker get away. She doesn’t think he can help Batgirl anymore, but a “bad today” doesn’t mean it’ll be a “bad tomorrow.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a party boat for Mac and Tosh when Tweety accidentally makes a mistake but doesn’t ask for help.

programme.desc: The Looney Builders try to help Winston Whale by building him a mail truck, but Winston is used to working alone.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Lola leads the crew in washing their vehicles only to discover she mixed up the job assignments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A crafty cat burglar is causing alarm and concern throughout the town with a series of daring rooftop robberies. After Mrs Wicket’s house is burgled and Bean has his wallet stolen he decides the only way to deal with this cunning housebreaker is to don a costume and become a superhero (like the ones in his favourite comic book). But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have found an Amerindian eagle amulet that endows he who wears it with the powers of a bird of prey. Grizzy would like to impress his beloved she-bear by soaring majestically through the sky. But to confiscate the magic totem from the Lemmings, who are now as sharp as eagles, Grizzy will have to use the cunning... of a puma.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with the ranger's electric guitar and the cabin walls tremble with their experimental rock. Just as Grizzy is about to destroy the instrument, he realizes it can make harmonious sounds too. Will this be enough to seduce the she-bear he's in love with?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: To finally be on an equal footing with Grizzy's imposing build and throw their own weight around in the cabin, the Lemmings decide to wear a blow-up sumotori costume.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover an ancient Amerindian table with the power to show you past events. They relive their prehistoric ancestors' first confrontations, and learn that chocolate spread was invented long, long ago.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover an old book of magic spells with a formula that enables one to take on the appearance of any other creature. The Lemmings have the bright idea of transforming one their kin into a double of the she-bear Grizzy is madly in love with in order to trick him. How could Grizzy refuse to give his jar of chocolate spread to his sweetheart?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When Grizzy propels the Lemmings out of the log cabin perched on the Great Wall of China, the critters land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest where they discover a box filled with fortune cookies. One Lemming gets super lucky after eating one. Armed with their magic cookies, the Lemmings set out to confront Grizzy. But each cookie represents a power… or a curse!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings love sesame nougat but Grizzy, who adores this treat too, steals their box. Quite upset, the rodents search for more, in vain. Instead, they discover the art of energy points in an old Chinese medicine book. Determined to recover their sweets regardless of the cost, the Lemmings activate Grizzy's vital points and the bear finds himself completely blocked. Thanks to the book, Grizzy frees himself and learns to master energies in turn.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After a game that ends abruptly, the Lemmings fall onto the roof of a temple where they discover drawings of Tai Chi movements. When carried out, the exercises generate a ball of energy! The Lemmings test out the sequence of movements on… Grizzy, until he is evicted from the cabin and falls onto the temple in turn. His fall unveils a new sequence of movements on a fresco that could create an even stronger energy flow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After being thrown out of the log cabin by Grizzy, the Lemmings find a dragon statue with a mysterious stone in a temple. Touching the stone makes a fleeting tattoo appear on their bellies, temporarily endowing them with the mastery of Shaolin Kung Fu. The Lemmings return to the cabin and uproot Grizzy with ease! But Grizzy has not said his last word and manages to get hold of the magic stone.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. During their scuffle, they knock over an army crate which falls into the middle of the bamboo forest surrounding the cabin. Alerted by the noise, a peace missionary panda comes out of the forest and tries to calm down the worked-up adversaries. But will the limitless strategies of Grizzy and the Lemmings get the better of the panda's patience?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings create a shadow puppet show where seven papercut lemmings confront a bear over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread. The Lemmings in the audience are super enthusiastic, but Grizzy is outraged by the treatment inflicted upon the bear. He decides to intervene and equips the paper bear with an armor and saber! The Lemmings retort with ninja effigies of themselves and mount an attack to recover the coveted jar of Yummy spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: As Grizzy relaxes in the massage chair, a cloud drifts in front of the sun, immediately stopping the electricity supply in the log cabin. The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings – using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.desc: Moley vows to not eat worms for a few days in support of Dotty’s veganism and his worm craving temptations get out of control.

programme.desc: When Chanterelle sees how good Lilit is at painting, she offers to help her dig into her talent. programme.desc: Baby Lynx is desperately looking for a worthy opponent to race against. When she sees the Baby Lemmings chasing an apple rolling down a slope, she wants to race against them. But in reality, they are really bad at it! Baby Lynx decides to train the Baby Lemmings in the hope of having real opponents.

programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself!

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: Team Tennyson discovers that a small village's goats are being terrorized by the legendary Chupacabra, but when Ben realizes it's actually Dr. Animo, our hero must thwart the dastardly doctor.

programme.desc: After winning a Sumo Slammers Champion belt, Ben returns to the Rustbucket to find his prize in the arms of Kevin, but when his rival hijacks the Rustbuggy instead, our hero must stop at nothing to get back what's rightfully his!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined. Bean ousts the pest from his house using the only language mime artists understand.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: To solve the mystery of a ghostly performer haunting her former venue, the Gang has to pretend to be a rock band themselves! But can they solve the case before Velma has to actually get on stage and sing?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred is excited to visit The Vault - a high security prison from which no convict has ever escaped. But when the ghost of Stealing Stan (JOHN DiMAGGIO), an inmate who always claimed to be innocent, terrorizes the prison, Fred has to solve the mystery and rethink his stance on criminal justice!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge. Grizzy and the Lemmings will do everything to break up this budding romance and recover the cold sources that are rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears. Grizzy is now obliged to treat them like brothers as well.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mr. Wicket gets a new lodger who is an Inventor, and a big nuisance, Bean discovers that he has to become ‘inventive’ himself. But, when your enemy is clever and sneaky, you have to be even cleverer and sneakier. Bean has never lost ‘a cleverness competition’, but maybe there is a first time for everything!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree. Bam will have to get used to having Batgirl in the driver's seat and learn something new if he's going to help her stop Mr. Freeze!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Set to his rocking theme song, Bam the Batmobile takes to the streets of Gotham and uses his smarts, leadership skills, and awesome gadgets to fight crime and stop the villainous Legion of Zoom.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: To escape a snowstorm, the gang checks into a creepy, massive hotel run by a man very strict about the hotel rules established by his deceased mother. The gang soon discovers the penalty for breaking the hotel rules is a horrifying scolding from the ghost of the owner's mother, herself!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang tours an old Hollywood Studio, but they soon uncover a mystery concerning the ghost of a silent film comedy star who has returned to make sure his recently discovered final film is never seen!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is jealous of the Lemmings’ new game: an interactive dance mat connected to the TV where the idea is to jump around and perform dance sequences. As they fight over the mat, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism in one of the Great Wall of China’s watchtowers. The mechanism activates a game on the wall’s paving stones that is similar to the interactive mat, only life size. On your marks, get ready, dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are hungry! While fighting over a jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the jar is destroyed. But Grizzy discovers an ingenious manner to recover the remains of another Yummy jar using instant Chinese noodles as inspiration. The result is delicious. Grizzy and the Lemmings will once again fight over this new Yummy-based recipe: Choco-noodles.

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: When Ben and family go to London to visit the legendary Big Ben, the Bugg Brothers are there to greet them, with yet another outrageously over the top plan of course: to shrink the Big Ben bell in order to steal it!

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: While visiting China, Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max take a trek to the Great Wall but their adventure is nearly ruined by daredevils LaGrange and Vin Ethanol trying to jump the international monument. Ben must hop into the Rustbuggy to chase away the fast and furious foes.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During a great Parasaur family migration, the Ranchers spot trouble. The youngest, Sneezer, is under the weather with booming sneezes that startle even himself, causing him to bolt away in panic! Min manages to calm him down just in time! Confident, Min volunteers to nurse Sneezer back to health while also taking on Uncle Jack's HQ duties. But caring for dinos is no easy feat, especially alone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: First impressions can be tricky, especially when a protective mama sea turtle mistakes the Jungle Jetter for a predator! The frightened mother is injured in a chase, leaving the Dino Ranchers rushing to her rescue! Back at HQ, Min carefully treats the mama's wounds while the others watch over her tiny hatchlings, safely tucked inside a pen! But one mischievous baby, Shelly, has other plans!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is no fan of wrestling. But he’s promised to take Mrs Wicket and her friend Mrs Wince to a big wrestling match in town. Bean finds himself lost backstage at the stadium and accidentally wanders through a door and straight into the wrestling ring where he finds himself up against Side Kick Rick. More by luck than talent Bean wins the match – only to find that now he has to fight the terrifying Bruise Force.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to see a very rare bird so he can tick off every page in his bird-spotting book. But he soon gets bored as he waits in a hide for the rare bird to appear. Instead he goes home and paints a picture of the bird cuts it out and sticks it high up a tree in the back garden. Soon he is besieged by excited twitchers who think it really is the rare bird. They are all keen to get a snap and they’re willing to pay good money for a peek.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: During a visit to London's National Gallery, Bean witnesses the theft of a major work of art. Bloodhound that he is, he pursues the culprit across the Channel to Paris only to be waylaid by a Reliant Robin, a traffic jam, and a mime artist under the Eiffel Tower. Will Mr Bean ‘the International Art Sleuth’ prove successful?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's been raining a lot these last few days! That's why the Baby Lemmings are discovering little croaking frogs! They're so much fun! Baby Chipmunk is having great difficulty climbing trees made slippery by the rain to reach her nuts. Seeing the frogs' long tongues, she decides to “borrow” them to make her job easier.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover a hollow branch filled with sap. When they blow into it, it makes bubbles! They have fun chasing and popping them. Baby Owl marvels at a few bubbles that have strayed near her nest and takes it upon herself to guide them out of the forest so that they can fly away without bursting. When she discovers the Baby Lemmings' game of popping as many bubbles as possible, she decides to put an end to it.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A robotic rule enforcer has been placed in the local park and is spoiling everyone's fun. Bugs takes it upon himself to enforce some rules of his own.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs attempts the path less traveled and finds himself in yet another stand-off between the Hazmats and Bigfoot.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: The Grim Rabbit takes a vacation only to discover Bugs is there too. Despite his wife's ultimatum of No Smiting the Grim Rabbit is set on trying to mix business with pleasure.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A entitled little girl named Pampreen takes all of Bugs carrots for her prize pony Puddin. Bugs and Squeaks go on a mission to get them back.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to a fancy Ice Hotel co-owned by her family where a new exhibit of ice age artifacts is opening. Things heat up, however, when a frozen Ice Man thaws out and goes on a rampage inside the hotel.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang heads to Shaggy's beloved grandmother's Florida retirement home, where they learn a crazed Ape Man has been frightening the elderly residents.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles. When the police arrive to investigate the theft of his landlady’s jewellery, it’s not just Mr. Bean that needs to take flight.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park. There’s a case of mistaken identity and Mr Bean finds himself teaching a class of unruly school kids. Bean uses every trick in the book to win them over and ends up teaching the headmaster how to be a success in school.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: The neighbor's cat turns out to be a hipster whose laidback attitudes and behaviors are soon adopted by Tom and the other alley cats. Annoyed, Jerry decides to put an end to all of their silly nonsense.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Jerry battles Tom to save a crab from becoming the Duke and Duchess's main course.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: After taking the heat again from Ginger for Jerry's shenanigans, fed up Tom decides to pack his bags and go home to his birth family. But can you ever really go home again?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is captivated by a mime artist on TV who makes viewers believe in the presence of an invisible wall. To get rid of the Lemmings, who have sights on his jar of Yummy, Grizzy hides the jar and pretends he has an invisible one. When the Lemmings see through the trick, they decide to trap Grizzy with a grand illusion number.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings shiver with cold, sneeze and are glassy-eyed: they have a big fat cold! They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Power Punch signs up for the strength tournament and blows everyone away. But his power causes an earthquake that threatens to destroy Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After refusing to practice with her new underwater mode, Batwing is unable to save Batman from Penguin's sunken ship trap. The Batwheels must help Wing practice her submersible skills before she can save the day.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After agreeing to swap motherboards and change bodies, the Batwheels have to quickly learn to “drive a mile in each other’s wheels” in time to stop the approaching Legion of Zoom!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. Always trying to one-up each other, these stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mayor Foghorn Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a lighthouse for Looneyburg, Lola’s tablet breaks and she must rely on herself.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders redesign the final hole of ACME Acres Mini Golf Course, and Porky is determined to get it just right for the kids.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Beaver Brothers hire The Looney Builders to build them a log cabin, but soon sidetrack the job by goofing around too much.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build a skate park for the kids, but it soon interferes with Hoots Talon and his friends’ activities.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: The crew plays Hide N’ Seek at headquarters and Tweety is the seeker.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is tidying his flat and chucking out a load of old unwanted junk. Unfortunately during the big clear out Teddy accidentally falls into a bin bag which gets put out in the street. Bean is horrified when the rubbish van arrives and he realises that dear old Teddy is now on his way to the landfill. Bean races across town to the dump but how will he ever find his friend amongst all the mountains of junk?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys a robot to clean his flat but it ends up trashing half the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by a noisy high-speed chase between the Lemmings and a raccoon, Grizzy abruptly stops the game. The players fall into empty space and land in a clearing. The impact of their crash-landing cracks a black and white tile representing Yin and Yang and a strange light pours over the raccoon. Depending on his mood, the color of his fur changes, and his excitement or calm become contagious to all those around him!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: On the way back from a fishing outing, Grizzy unwittingly brings back an electrode that controls a robot. Once activated, the gadget puts itself in the service of the bear, satisfying his each and every need. The envious Lemmings plot to take possession of this new metallic ally. They manage to evict the bear, who does not intend to take this lying down… especially when he discovers a pair of robotic arms hidden in a module that fell out of the robot!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: At nightfall, just as Grizzy starts to doze off, a racket comes from outside the cabin: the Lemmings are sliding along the Great Wall in a crate, propelled by firework rockets. Cleverly avoiding the bear's strategies to stop them, the Lemmings accidentally set off a mechanism in a tower. A secret room filled with cannons and catapults opens, just waiting to be used by the powder monkey apprentices…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread in the cabin and it ends up sinking in the lagoon. The bear makes a diving suit from various home facilities, while the Lemmings share a diving tank to put a wrench in their adversary's flippers! But the local wildlife comes to meet them…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy wakes up after a nap, starving, but the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread is empty. The cupboards are barren, except for a package of chocolate powder. Grizzy has the idea of mixing it with coconut milk. It's absolutely delicious! But the Lemmings, who are every bit as gluttonous, want their share of the choco-coco drink!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy gets a nice big bite on the end of his fishing line. While he concentrates hard to strike his catch, the Lemmings divert the fish to tow them on a kite. Grizzy tries to sabotage their improvised kitesurfing game to recover what's rightfully his, until a shark's fin appears on the horizon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The cupboards of the log cabin are hopelessly empty and Grizzy's belly is rumbling. Through his binoculars, he observes the overexcited Lemmings slipping all sorts of small metal objects into the slot of… a Yummy vending machine!?! The bear joins them on the pontoon. If only they could find some coins to make the machine work. Maybe the solution is to find the booty indicated on the treasure map they unearthed on the beach?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After accidentally breaking his favorite sofa, Grizzy spots a cozy fishing cabin on a neighboring island. He requisitions the Lemmings' canoe to get there but discovers that the new cabin is dilapidated and lacking all comfort. The poor bear had been deluded by a poster. However, a fabulous yacht is moored nearby. It catches both his attention and that of the Lemmings, who have just disembarked on the island!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun taking potshots at sand statues depicting Grizzy. Outraged, he catapults them far into the distance. Grizzy takes advantage of their absence to erect a monumental sculpture of himself. But just as he takes a selfie in front of the sculpture, Grizzy realizes that the Lemmings have laid hands on… a pirate cannon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After being hit over the head, the Lemmings become hypnotized by a fitness poster and take themselves for sports coaches. They are determined to forcefully train Grizzy, who would much rather lounge around than do push-ups and squats. But the Lemmings' new personality makes them particularly overbearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Nothing seems to be biting Grizzy's fishing rod and the bear is in despair. Suddenly he spots a fabulous swordfish swimming in the lagoon. The bear is already licking his chops, when he sees the Lemmings straddling the fish in a rodeo game. From inside the cabin he uses as a mooring post, Grizzy manages to snare the swordfish and is about to pull it in, but the Lemmings are riding it toward the high seas. Each party tugs hard. And the cabin starts to slide…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that several drops of Tabasco sauce poured into a rock fault releases powerful sprays of steam that propel them high into the sky on a pot lid. Except that the entire volcanic island shudders each time the drops are poured. Grizzy, who has decided to take a nap in his hammock, confiscates the bottle before realizing that the Lemmings have an entire stock !

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have decided to organize a race with two sand yachts they found on the beach. The only thing missing, is a worthy adversary. They put Grizzy, who was taking a nap, on one of the yachts without waking him up. And the race is off. Grizzy wakes up in shock onboard his sand yacht.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has run out of ideas to open his coconut until he sees the Lemmings' new friend the crab open one with a simple snip of the claw. He confiscates the crustacean and uses it to take the tops off his coconuts. As they fight over the crab, the characters discover a remote-control device in a secret grotto that operates a giant crab. Grizzy takes over the controls, but the Lemmings want to play with the joystick too!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A helicopter takes off from the beach, leaving behind installations for a TV game, namely lots of food supplies – which are locked up. To access the keys and the food, participants must win team tests under the surveillance of a drone. The Lemmings are the yellow team. The red team is comprised of Grizzy, an oar, and a flabbergasted crab!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Toms cīnās ar nodevību un sastopas ar pazīstamu seju; Katrīna meklē risinājumu melnā cauruma briesmām.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Nāvējoša sadursme noved pie dzīvībai bīstama brīža; Katrīna un Sems meklē palīdzību viņa vecākiem.

programme.title: Saules pretstati 2
programme.desc: Ak! Dīvains stāsts, kas izskaidro, kāpēc Terijai nācās pasūtīt jaunu šota glāzi.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K
programme.desc: Lou, feeling like M.O.D.O.K. is stifling his individuality ahead of his bar mitzvah, jumps into M.O.D.O.K.’s portal to Asgard. There, Lou is taken by a tribe of goblins known as Kobolds, but wins them over with his magic tricks and becomes their leader. He refuses to go back home with his dad, so M.O.D.O.K. takes control of an army of Asgardian warriors and wages war against his son. Eventually, M.O.D.O.K. and Lou strike a deal and use Lou's magic tricks to pacify the Kobolds. Meanwhile, the Super Adaptoid agrees to help young M.O.D.O.K.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Kamēr Aila pārdomā Bila patiesos motīvus, viņš vēršas pie Zojas ar lūgumu, kas grupā izraisa kārtējo saspringto konfrontāciju.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Atkalapvienojušies Londonā, Ketrīna un Bils dalās zināšanās par citplanētiešiem un izdara satriecošu atklājumu par to, kā šī ārpuszemes civilizācija radusies.

programme.title: Pasauļu karš
programme.desc: Izdzīvojušie gatavojas uzbrukumam, kas var mainīt visu. Uz Bila pleciem gulstas visas pasaules liktenis, bet vai viņš spēs uzņemties atbildību brīdī, kad no viņa būs atkarīga visas cilvēces izdzīvošana?

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: When Cain’s elective surgery patient returns with complications, Mina and Raptor butt heads over how to handle the situation. Conrad and Devon treat a local Congresswoman who withholds information that could prevent her from receiving proper treatment, causing Devon to open up about his grief. In the wake of losing many colleagues to the virus, Bell worries who would be there for him in a moment of crisis and finds himself mining his own past to find his estranged former stepson, elite plastic surgeon Dr. Jake Wong (guest star Conrad Ricamora). Meanwhile, Logan Kim finds himself on the chopping block when the doctors are questioned about his actions during the pandemic.

programme.title: Rezidents
programme.desc: When Cain tries to be a hero at a crash scene, he is struck by a car, causing Chastain’s doctors to put aside their personal issues to try and save his life. Conrad and Nic team up to help one of the crash victims, whose secretive past makes it difficult to identify a diagnosis. Meanwhile, Bell brings his TV crew to the hospital in hopes of garnering positive attention for Chastain, and Mina opens up to Nic, only to find out that Nic is holding on to a secret of her own.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Mereditas pēdējā dienā Grejas Slouna slimnīcā ārsti ieplāno atvadu pārsteigumu un Niks uzsāk sarunu ar viņu par abu attiecību nākotni; interni sacenšas, lai piedalītos revolucionārā procedūrā; Ričards uzdod Tedijam svarīgu jautājumu.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Tedijs pieņem sarežģītu lēmumu; Megija un Vinstons nesarunājas; Links paļaujas uz Džo, lai saņemtu emocionālu atbalstu, gatavojoties pazīstama sportista operācijai; Simonu un Lūkasu pārsteidz neparasts viesis.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Simone saskaras ar lēmumu, kas izmaina viņas dzīvi, atgriežoties kādam no viņas pagātnes; Blū un Džūla pavada Megiju riskantā pacienta ārstēšanā; Džo un Links aprūpē grūtnieci; Lūkass un Mika rīko pārsteigumu pilnu ballīti.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Katrīna atgriežas Grejas Slouna slimnīcā, lai veiktu ķirurģisku operāciju, kas Lūkasam un Blū liek justies neomulīgi; Amēlija ārstē iespējamu vēža pacientu, kura ģimene viņu pāraprūpē; Ouens sāk uzņemties atbildību par savu medicīnisko nākotni, kas Tedijam ir liels pārsteigums.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: After a car crashes into Joe's Bar, Andy and Sullivan lead the team of firefighters as they work to rescue their fellow crew mates Ben and Pruitt, Grey Sloan doctors and interns, and bar patrons before the building collapses.

programme.title: 19. ugunsdzēsēju depo
programme.desc: The new Seattle fire chief is introduced to STATION 19 and leaves the crew skeptical after his visit. Later, the firefighters are called to a department store fire caused by exploding fireworks, which triggers painful memories from Ben's past and inspires him to pursue a new endeavor. Maya advocates for herself and her career, while Jack becomes more intertwined with an acquaintance; and Andy and Ryan have a heart-to-heart.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Neplānota tikšanās apvieno Gabiju ar viņas bijušo mīļāko un dārznieku Džonu; Brī pārdomā kopīgu nedēļas nogali ar Karlu; Lineta un Toms paziņo bērniem, ka viņa ir stāvoklī; Sjūzena ir pārliecināta, ka Endžijas dēls ir atbildīgs par viņas meitas uzbrukumu.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Maika zaudējums smagi ietekmē Ketrīnu. Kamēr viņa zaudē pamatu zem kājām, Brī nāk viņai palīgā; Gabija sāk apnikt Džona nodomi pret Anu; dvīņu gaidībās Lineta lūdz ģimeni aktīvāk iesaistīties mājas darbos; Sjūzena uzzina, ka Džūlija slēpj kādus noslēpumus; bet Endžija rīko ballīti savam dēlam Denijam.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Edisone ierodas Greja Slouna memoriālajā slimnīcā, lai sveiktu Beilijas jaunos dzemdniecības un ginekoloģijas praktikantus; pārvešanas laikā pazūd Megijas plaušu transplantāts; Niks satuvinās ar Lukasu, bet tad notiek kas šokējošs.

programme.title: Grejas anatomija
programme.desc: Tūlīt pēc šokējošajiem notikumiem klīnikā slimnīca slēdz visas durvis, un Greja Slouna memoriālās slimnīcas ārsti sadalās grupās, lai glābtu vairākas dzīvības; Megija kopā ar Vinstonu nonāk briesmās; negaidīti ierodas Džūlas istabas biedrs.

programme.title: Mīlasstāsts: Džons F. Kenedijs jaunākais un Karolīna Besete
programme.desc: Pēc ģimenes traģēdijas Džons meklē Karolīnas atbalstu.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Gabija cenšas pierādīt, ka ir atbildīga māte; Ketrīna un Sjūzena nonāk uz kara takas; jauns meistars aizvaino Linetu; Denija kļūda noved pie smagas nelaimes.

programme.title: Bīstamās mājsaimnieces
programme.desc: Brī sāk iemīlēties Karlā; Ketrīna turpina mēģinājumus iekarot Maiku, vēl vairāk saasinot konfliktu ar Sjūzenu; Gabija panāk, ka Huanita tiek izraidīta no skolas; Endžija atsakās atklāt patiesību par savu māti.

programme.title: ROZVUDS
programme.desc: Holivudas spožumā un Maiami modes nedēļas glamūrā tiek izstrādāts plāns nogalināt vienu no pilsētas karstākajiem jauniem dizaineriem, kurš vēršas pie Rozvuda pēc palīdzības. Kad lieta aizved Rozvudu un Villu no modes skates uz noziegumu vietu, Rozvuds uzzina par kopīgu pagātni ar upuri. Piesaistot labākā drauga Dr. Maika Boisa palīdzību, Rozvuds nejauši pamudina Villu atgriezties randiņu pasaulē. Kupidona bulta skārusi arī Donnu, kura izmēģina tiešsaistes iepazīšanos. Tikmēr Pipijas un TMI attiecības piedzīvo krīzi, kad Pipija atklāj, ka TMI ir kāds liels noslēpums.

programme.title: ROZVUDS
programme.desc: Rozvuds un Villa ienirst Maiami mākslas pasaulē, lai noķertu sērijveida slepkavu, kurš grasās radīt patiesu “šedevru”. Kad medību grupai pievienojas TMI bijušais līgavainis, FBI detektīvs Hīts Kazablanka, viņš apdraud Pīpijas un TMI attiecības. Hīts arī nonāk konfliktā ar Hornstoku, kurš varētu kļūt par policijas priekšnieku, ja noķers slepkavu. Tikmēr gaidāma tiesvedība pret Rozvudu apdraud Magic City Laboratorijas pastāvēšanu un liek Donnai nopietni pārdomāt, kā viņas dēls dzīvo savu dzīvi. Savukārt Rozvuds cenšas pasargāt Villu no sava labākā drauga, Maika.

programme.title: Liels Potenciāls
programme.desc: Morganas aizdomas par Rīsu kļūst arvien spēcīgākas, turpinoties pazudušā Rembranta mākslas darba lietai; Romāna pazudusī mugursoma sagādā problēmas visiem iesaistītajiem.

programme.title: ROZVUDS
programme.desc: Rozvuds un Villa nonāk Evergleidas tumšajā pasaulē, kad viņi sadarbojas ar Hornstoka bijušo partneri, tagad atlīdzību mednieku Floidu Beiteru, lai noķertu slepkavu. Tikmēr Pipijai tiek dota unikāla iespēja uzsākt mūzikas karjeru, bet Villa cenšas atjaunot saiknes ar māti.

programme.title: ROZVUDS

programme.title: Ledus laikmets: Lielā sadursme
programme.desc: Skreta (Kriss Vedžs) nepārtrauktie pūliņi noglabāt savu zīli, liek viņam izraisīt negadījumu virkni, kuru rezultātā asteroīdi sāk traukties uz Zemi. Haoss liek Manijam (Rejs Romano), Djego (Deniss Līrijs), Sidam (Džons Legvizamo) un viņu ģimenēm meklēt patvērumu. Piedzīvojumu meklētāja zebiekste Baks (Saimons Pegs) viņus brīdina, ka var sākties masveida izmiršana, kas liek draugiem meklēt jaunu mājvietu, pa ceļam satiekot citus dzīvniekus un apmeklējot eksotiskas vietas.

programme.title: Nejaukais es 2
programme.desc: Kamēr bijušais dižais ļaundaris Gru sāk iejusties ģimenes cilvēka lomā un mēģina godīgi pelnīt iztiku, pārdodot ievārījumu, Antarktīdā kāds nozog slepenu laboratoriju. Ļaunuma apkarošanas organizācijai ir nepieciešama palīdzība, un tās pārstāvji ierodas pie Gru. Kopā ar organizācijas ekscentrisko aģenti Lūsiju Vaildu viņš secina, ka galvenais aizdomās turamais ir par mirušu uzskatītais supernelietis El Mačo, kura dēls ir ieskatījies Gru vecākajā meitā Margo. Pārlieka vēlēšanās pasargāt meitas un arvien pieaugošās simpātijas pret Lūsiju aizmiglo Gru prātu, tādēļ meklējumi nevedas. Tikmēr kāds nelietis paklusām nolaupa Gru palīgus.

programme.title: Kapteinis Zobenzobs un burvju dimants

Pusnaktī tas spēj piepildīt viskvēlāko vēlēšanos, lai kāda tā būtu. Taču visi meklējumi “kaķim zem astes”, kad, klejodams pa džungļiem, burvju dārgakmeni nejauši ierauga mazais Marks.
